KGACG (Knowledge-Guided Application-Level Code Generation), no version: closed loop of three agents, Code Organization & Planning Agent (COPA), Coding Agent (CA), Testing Agent (TA), with knowledge bases and feedback mechanism

Inputs: Software Requirements Specification (SRS: functional requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria) and Architectural Design Document (ADD: module decomposition, interface contracts, design patterns, stack), per IEEE 830 / ISO 29148 templates and traceability matrices. Generated: code implementation plan (JSON: component dependency graph, ordered implementation list), project directory structure, third-party API list, source code, compilation logs, code quality report, unit tests with traceability links (requirement ID + method), test reports

COPA analyses SRS + ADD -> code implementation plan + project structure -> CA analyses third-party APIs, generates code, compiles and self-debugs -> TA plans and generates unit tests from SRS/ADD and code, reports -> feedback loop (CA rectifies; COPA revises plan on errors) -> escalation to manual audit for persistent issues
Escalation to manual auditing for persistent or complex issues; otherwise autonomous. Humans supply SRS and ADD
